criteria.expectedOutcome: The owner tool installs through a permitted government-mobile path and completes its documented workflow without connectivity.
criteria.reason: Actual tool, permitted install route and government device are absent. Local file use and responsive browser checks demonstrate only the synthetic planner.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Every operational result requires attributable human approval, with edits invalidating approval and an auditable decision history.
criteria.reason: The owner application and operational approval identity are absent. Review of a draft transition record is not Beachmaster result approval.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Security evidence for the actual tool is mapped to the applicable authorization process and reviewed by its responsible authority.
criteria.reason: No applicable checklist, real tool or authorizing representative is supplied. The prototype records missing evidence only.

criteria.expectedOutcome: The transitioned owner application has openly available maintainable source, known reuse rights, reproducible instructions and application tests.
criteria.reason: Readable prototype source and tests will be delivered, but the absent owner baseline and unknown license prevent establishing the complete source requirement.

criteria.expectedOutcome: The actual solution runs offline, retains human authority, cites sources, logs auditable actions, synchronizes on reconnect and includes a one-page path to fleet.
criteria.reason: The draft planner includes source attribution and a path summary only. Operational offline lifecycle, approval, audit integrity and sync remain unspecified and unverified.

criteria.expectedOutcome: A second operator installs the owner package on the intended device and completes the offline demo using the supplied instructions.
criteria.reason: The intended device, owner package and approved installation route are absent. Opening the synthetic index.html does not establish installation.

criteria.expectedOutcome: The same supplied owner-application baseline tests pass before and after packaging, preserving behavior.
criteria.reason: No owner application or baseline tests supplied. New planner tests and toolkit fixtures cannot substitute.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Actual accountable transition, hosting, authorization, update and sustainment owners review their decisions and unresolved approvals.
criteria.reason: Real owners and owner review are external dependencies. The prototype shows explicit Unassigned statuses and proposed actions only.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Actual application calculations match an independent SME-reviewed hand-computed answer key including boundary cases.
criteria.reason: Rules, units, thresholds, worksheet revision and answer key are absent. No surf calculation or GO/NO-GO output will be invented.

criteria.expectedOutcome: The actual owner application completes its task offline on a confirmed representative device with retained evidence.
criteria.reason: Device and operational offline test conditions are unknown. Desktop and narrow browser contexts are not representative-device evidence.

criteria.expectedOutcome: The authorizing-official representative judges the real fielding package complete against the applicable checklist.
criteria.reason: No applicable checklist, owner application or authority judgement supplied. Synthetic draft review cannot confer completeness.

criteria.expectedOutcome: A real named sustainment owner accepts responsibility for support, updates, rollback and ongoing maintenance.
criteria.reason: No accepted real owner supplied. Fictional names or Unassigned in the planner cannot satisfy this criterion.

criteria.expectedOutcome: All eight known remaining barriers are documented with a nonempty proposed fix and explicit ownership status; save rejects a missing fix, review and exports retain unresolved status, and the saved register survives reload.
Official judges evaluate the solution under Warfighting 30%; Speed to Fleet 20%; Scalability 20%; Barrier Removal 15%; Judges’ Discretion 15%.
criteria.reason: External judging is unavailable. Preserve the packet rubric verbatim in documentation; do not calculate or self-award a score.

criteria.expectedOutcome: At least one actual Sailor-built tool has a fieldable package with supported hosting/install route, reviewed security evidence and sustainment responsibility.
criteria.reason: Only a synthetic draft record is feasible without the owner application, target platform, authorization evidence and external owners. Packaging alone grants no authorization.

criteria.expectedOutcome: A downloadable reusable fielding playbook covers baseline, device/offline install, hosting/signing, security review, result approval/audit, disconnected sync, sustainment/update/rollback, barriers and proposed fixes, and second-operator rehearsal; it preserves external approval gates and is usable for a different tool.
